pairs.subject: broadcast-software-control
pairs.evidence: packages/stage-kit/src/ui/index.ts:2 These React components are the page that OBS renders inside a browser source, not a client that drives OBS. A search of packages/stage-kit for obs-websocket, inputUuid/input_uuid, sceneItemId, CreateInput and RemoveInput found nothing. The only OBS control code in the repo is crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/record/mod.rs, so none of the subject's create, remove, ledger, reconnect or credential concerns can arise in this context.

techniques.evidence: packages/stage-kit/src/ui/index.ts:2 These components are content shown inside OBS. They create no OBS sources or scenes, so they have nothing to record in a ledger.
packages/stage-kit/src/ui/Browser.tsx:2 These components open no control socket, so no password is held here. A grep for password and ws:// in src/ui found nothing.
packages/stage-kit/src/ui/index.ts:2 No code here creates, adopts or cleans up OBS objects. That logic lives in the daemon's record module.
packages/stage-kit/src/ui/Browser.tsx:2 There is no OBS connection here, so there is no reconnect path.
packages/stage-kit/src/ui/index.ts:2 The components read the show's scene model, not OBS state, so they never check whether an OBS scene or source exists.
packages/stage-kit/src/ui/Browser.tsx:2 No removal requests are sent from here, so there is nothing to verify.
